note: Merchant, front view, empty-handed. Both arms are puffy white sleeves ending in a dark cuff at the wrist: the sleeve narrows at the top (upper arm) and bunches into folds lower down, so the elbow is the fold at y~512; the white lower sleeve with its dark cuff is forearm down to the wrist (left y603, right y602), and the bare fists below are hands (y600-680). Hip y~648 (bottom of the vest, where the olive shorts begin); shorts and the bare skin below their hem (y735-755) are thigh; no knee mark, so the knee is the boot top y755 on both legs; ankles at the instep y800.
